personality: 7 Dark-First Utility (with 6 Glass / Luxe ritual overlays and gothic occult styling)
personality_one_liner: Un duello di tarocchi satirici dark e drammatico in stile Yu-Gi-Oh, dove ogni arcano evoca l'abisso con 8000 LP e tributi sacrileghi.

spacing.rule: Generous tactical spacing for duel mat layout with precise touch zones

do's: Use frosted glass panels over the duel mat for graveyard and spell zones
Apply cinematic glass overlays on card inspection modals
dont's: Never blur active LP counters or critical combat numbers
Do not use heavy blur on text-heavy duel logs

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Occult main menu with game modes, quick duel initiation, and satirical tarot lore.

states.empty: Nessun mazzo trovato. Crea il tuo primo mazzo satirico.
states.error: Errore nel caricamento del grimorio. Riprova.

screens.layout: Vertical scroll with mystical header banner, active LP status badge, primary 'Inizia Duello' ritual button, difficulty selector chips (Facile, Normale, Incubo), and bottom navigation.

screens.name: Duello
screens.purpose: The heart of the app: Yu-Gi-Oh style 3D duel arena with 8000 LP, tribute summons, attack/defense positions, support zones, and cinematic combat.

states.empty: Nessuna carta in mano. Pesca dal mazzo degli arcani.

screens.layout: Full-screen vertical duel mat: Opponent LP & hand at top, opponent monster/support zones, central combat arena with attack/defense indicators, player monster/support zones, player hand cards with drag/press actions, and bottom sticky action drawer (End Phase, Attack Declaration, Tribute Summon).

screens.name: Galleria
screens.purpose: Tarot card collection catalog with satirical artwork, lore descriptions, and deck management.

states.empty: Collezione vuota. Sblocca le carte vincendo i duelli.

screens.layout: Grid view (2 columns) with category filters (Arcani Maggiori, Satirici, Supporto), card preview thumbnails with metallic borders, and detail inspection modal.

screens.name: Storico
screens.purpose: Match history, win/loss statistics, and dueling records against AI difficulties.

states.loading: Consultando i registri del tribunale arcano...
states.empty: Nessun duello registrato. Scendi nell'arena per iniziare la leggenda.

screens.layout: Header stat cards (Vittorie, Sconfitte, Winrate), followed by chronological list of duel match records with opponent difficulty badge, outcome indicator, and final LP difference.

tarot_banner.alt: Dark occult tarot dueling aesthetic background

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all text is in fluent Italian as requested.

Implement full Yu-Gi-Oh duel mechanics: 8000 LP bars, Attack/Defense position switches, Tribute Summons (1 tribute for 5-6 stars, 2 for 7+), Support zone with 2 activations per turn, and AI opponent with 3 difficulties (Novizio, Adepto, Incubo).
Maintain the dark occult gothic atmosphere using deep obsidian (#0A0B0E), crimson brand accents (#A82424), and antique gold highlights (#D4AF37).
Strictly follow typography rules: max font weight 500, Cinzel for display headers and Plus Jakarta Sans for body text.
Ensure touch targets are >= 44x44pt and all screens include robust loading, empty, and error states.
